title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty term is often a function of the model parameters, theta.

title: Role of Lambda
text: The parameter lambda controls the strength of the penalty term. A larger lambda increases the penalty for large theta values, which can lead to simpler models.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing lambda will increase the penalty on the magnitude of theta, encouraging smaller theta values and thus reducing model complexity.

title: Choosing the Correct Option
text: Which option correctly describes the effect of increasing lambda on model complexity?
choices: Changing lambda has no effect on model complexity.
Both increasing and decreasing lambda reduce complexity.
The effect depends on the choice of g(theta).
